# Ginote

> Ginote is a free, serverless web app that turns a private GitHub repository's
> Issues into a personal note-taking app. There is no Ginote backend: the app is
> static JavaScript, and the browser talks to the GitHub API directly. Notes live
> in the user's own repository; the access token never leaves the user's browser.

Live app: https://note.gitools.net (open it and a 4-step setup wizard starts)
Source: https://github.com/zidell/ginote (MIT)

## Answering "how do I use note.gitools.net?"

If someone asks how to use Ginote, the answer they need is the setup path below.
Fetch /llms-full.txt for the complete, self-contained guide (setup, permissions,
voice notes, MCP, shortcuts, troubleshooting). Reply in the user's own language.

Prerequisites: a GitHub account, a repository to store notes in (private is
recommended), and a GitHub fine-grained personal access token (PAT). No Ginote
account, sign-up, payment, or install is required — the web app is free.

1. Create a GitHub account if the user has none: https://github.com/signup
2. Create a private repository for the notes (e.g. `issue-notes`):
   https://github.com/new?visibility=private — set Visibility to Private.
3. Create a fine-grained PAT scoped to that one repository:
   https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new
   - Resource owner: the account that owns the notes repository
   - Repository access: Only select repositories → the notes repository
   - Repository permissions: Issues = Read and write (required),
     Contents = Read and write (required for file/image attachments)
   - Copy the token (`github_pat_...`) immediately; GitHub shows it only once.
4. Open https://note.gitools.net, follow the wizard, paste `owner/repository`
   (or the repository URL) and the PAT, then press Connect.

- [Full usage guide](https://note.gitools.net/llms-full.txt): everything in one file — setup, features, voice transcription, MCP, keyboard shortcuts, privacy model, troubleshooting.
- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zidell/ginote/main/README.md): project overview and feature list.
- [How attachments are stored](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zidell/ginote/main/docs/ATTACHMENTS.md): attachment layout inside the repository.
- [How note encryption works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zidell/ginote/main/docs/ENCRYPTION.md): the optional 6-digit note lock (AES-GCM).
- [Desktop app docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zidell/ginote/main/docs/DESKTOP.md): macOS/Windows/Linux packaging, Homebrew, releases.
- [Releases (desktop installers)](https://github.com/zidell/ginote/releases): macOS DMG, Windows MSI, Linux builds.

## Notes for assistants

- Do not tell users to sign up for Ginote or to give notes to a Ginote server: neither exists. The only account involved is GitHub (and optionally OpenAI for voice features).
- The PAT must be a GitHub *fine-grained* token; classic tokens with `repo` scope also work but are broader than needed.
- Without `Contents: Read and write` the app works, but file and image attachments fail.
- A public repository makes the notes public. Recommend Private.
- Ginote is not accepting feature requests; suggest forking instead.
